scope: Independent reviewers supplied initial findings. Main agent repaired and verified the final assets. Not human listening or an independent second subjective audition.

fixes.finding: Timpani incorrectly treated as unpitched percussion with random drum changes.
fixes.resolution: Measure all 20 principal-modal references, select closest drum before velocity/RR, transpose each selected recording to written D2–A3 target.
fixes.evidence: score-production-report.json: timpani, source.timpaniCalibration and cue.timpaniRenderedChecks in distributed manifest; score-assets.test.ts

fixes.finding: Final tonic attack omitted by ending cutoff; both real melodies previously ended on E instead of D.
fixes.resolution: Rewrite penultimate-bar cadence so final melody really plays D3 before the release-only last bar; assertions check actual events; real browser waits for both cues to finish.

fixes.finding: Cold download follows mutable master and cached files are accepted by existence.
fixes.resolution: Pin immutable commit and actual tree; verify every WAV and license against Git blob SHA-1 plus recorded SHA-256. Disposable corrupt-cache download and wrong-blob rejection tests passed.

fixes.finding: Audio decoder cache and stalled transports could grow or remain pending; diagnostics must distinguish targets from actual gains.
fixes.resolution: Prune nonplaying cues, expose soft-budget overshoot, abort stale requests and bound each format network read; actual gain/duck and effective intensity are separate from pending targets.
fixes.evidence: unit-report.json: score.test.ts; score-browser-report.json: levels, pressureFixture, paused, cancelledTransitions

reproductionNote: 18 WAV masters and all36 decoded PCM identical on separate-output regeneration; MP3 containers identical. OGG only random stream serial/CRC differs, explicitly not 36 byte-identical containers.
remainingBoundary: No human audition; free community samples and deterministic arranging may still sound mechanical.
